fields.statement: Verifier at 3b55185c: go test -trimpath -count=1 -v ./internal/tui/autonomyapp/... passed all 7 tests with a fake runner: TestStartsAtDaemonSettings (the four Select fields Plan/Accept/Ship/Sign-off start at the daemon.settings values owner/auto/auto/owner), TestSubmitWritesChangedOnly (changing plan and ship then submitting makes exactly 2 daemon.set calls, values written, shell closed), TestSubmitUnchangedWritesNothing (0 sets, closed), TestEscCallsNothing (after changing a field, Esc makes 0 sets and closes), TestSetErrorIsResult, TestResultIsDaemonSettings. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(tui-autonomy-app|tui-health|describe-golden)$' passed: tui app autonomy --once cmp-matches rhiza daemon settings --json before and after a set. Read the diff: submit skips unchanged toggles and calls daemon.set with [--, key, value], which requestFromArgs in cmd/rhiza/argv.go maps to the key/value positional args; cmd/rhiza/tui.go runs the app in its modal shell and keeps --once on Result. go vet and gofmt clean.
